gold: Carcinoma erysipelatoides arising from triple-negative breast cancer

selector.rationale: The presence of multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels supports Carcinoma Erysipelatoides, which is a rare skin manifestation of metastatic cancer.

rejected.label: Radiation Dermatitis
rejected.why: While radiation dermatitis could explain the erythema and location over the operation site, the presence of carcinoma cells in lymphatic vessels and the specific appearance of the lesions better support Carcinoma Erysipelatoides.
